services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Are you looking for a way for your child to grow, play and adventure with us this summer? The Hayward Area Recreation and Park District offers an amazing array of summer camps for a variety of interests and ages. These camps take place throughout the District and offer your child a summer they will never forget! You’ll find something that will keep your child active and learning while they are out of school. A variety of schedules, activities and prices bring the summer camp experience within reach of every family. Fill your child’s summer with fun, excitement, and tons of new friends!
